brief:
Israeli occupation forces are continuing to breach the ceasefire agreement and conducting strikes across multiple areas of Gaza, according to Shehab Wire. The military has resumed airstrikes and gunfire operations targeting civilian zones throughout the enclave. Local sources confirmed that artillery bombardment struck east of Bureij camp in central Gaza, with additional fire directed at surrounding neighborhoods in the densely populated sector.

The resumption of military operations represents a significant breach of the agreed ceasefire terms. Residents reported hearing explosions throughout the morning as Israeli forces targeted positions across the territory, raising immediate concerns about the stability of the accord and the safety of civilians in affected areas.
